object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: On a clean machine without draw.io desktop (no draw.io install folder, none on PATH, MELLON_DRAWIO unset), install Mellon, start the GUI, open a copy of the req-test fixture, edit an attribute value and a description and commit. Expected: the GUI starts, each edit and the commit succeed, and Edit in draw.io says that draw.io isn't installed and changes nothing.
